svg.title: qa-platformBE — backend architecture
svg.text: Bounded contexts — api / application / domain / infrastructure
cross-context access only through infrastructure ACL adapters (ArchUnit)
Shared kernel, legacy layer and enforcement
Durable pipelines — every process-boundary crossing is a claimed row (G4, G5)
Inbound limiter in memory per instance
Imports and sync answer 202 + a job row
Import, sync and AI job workers (row claims)
Outbox relay · retention sweeps · nightly batch
scenarios, export, SSL certs and audit,
Used only via other BCs' acl adapters
a rate-limit bucket, not a tenant)
resolved only from lib/core-m2 (+ GitHub Packages)
InProcessTransport — every run in this JVM today
HttpAgentTransport — MOBILE with an agent URL:
Decided: out of process, customer-side runner
Per-provider payload + JSON schema on sync
Decided: egress is an organisation setting
Off by default · decided: run notifications
Spring Security OAuth2 client, any OIDC
Decided: SAML in the paid SSO tier
checked on save and before each call (G2)
JPA + Spring Data · Flyway V1…V125 + U undo
security: JWT, STOMP authz, OutboundUrlPolicy, redactor
importspec, analytics, auth, ssl, user entities
TestScenario rows are what every launch executes;
canonical cases reach them through projection
Decided: one stored model for every door (§1.2)
TransactionBoundaryRulesTest: no I/O in a tx (G4)

Three state machines stay independent: canonical review · execution · sync job (working rule 7). Only plan-path runs of connector cases create a sync job today; decided: recorded suite and feature runs too (SYN-03).
Spring Boot 3.5 · Java 21 · hexagonal bounded contexts · PostgreSQL + Flyway · 70,100 lines of main source in 987 files
Verified against the code on 2026-10-20 · dashed = decided in alcance.md, not built
